content.scenario.shared: An automated caption sounds plausible, but it may miss how sound and image work together in the audiovisual story.
content.prompt.evidence: What evidence would you seek before trusting the caption as an adequate reading of the work?
content.prompt.alternative: Give one plausible alternative explanation for the caption or its omissions.
content.prompt.limit: Name one claim the caption alone cannot establish.
content.instruction.pre: Answer before the production activity. Explain your reasoning rather than listing tools.
content.instruction.post: Answer after the V2 and audience exchange. Explain what changed in your evidence standard, if anything.
